method_note: Counted the 9 contributed-paper sessions in the 12th IAA Symposium on the Future of Space Exploration technical program (Turin, 9-11 June 2025, release 5 June 2025); 40 papers. Sessions in this program are numbered but untitled, so the bracketed descriptions were written from the paper titles in each session. Keynote sessions 1, 3 and 8 and the two round tables excluded. Each session weighted equally, split 50/50 where two keywords apply.
